items.snippet: # BOSS Coffee unveils ‘BOSS MODE: ON’ campaign to support Vietnam’s everyday workforce. Our **What’s NEXT in Marketing 2026 Conference Series** returns to the Philippines, Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia—and for the first time in Thailand! **Vietnam –** BOSS Coffee and Dentsu Creative Vietnam have launched ‘BOSS MODE: ON’, a campaign for the brand’s new energy drink that celebrates the blue-collar workers who keep everyday life moving. According to BOSS Coffee, the campaign reflects the combination of physical stamina, mental focus, and confidence needed by many workers managing demanding schedules and everyday responsibilities. HANOI, Vietnam (AP) — Police in Vietnam seized more than 400 cats in a major bust of a cat meat crime ring in Ho Chi Minh City, according to animal welfare groups and local media reports. This operation is “a sobering reminder of the enormous scale of Viet Nam’s cat meat trade,” Karanvir Kukreja, who leads a campaign against dog and cat meat consumption for the international nonprofit Humane World for Animals, said in a statement.
